name: Tatnai
bio: Tatnai, Persian governor of the province beyond the Euphrates, came with Shethar-bozenai and their associates to question the Jews rebuilding the Jerusalem temple, asking who had authorized it. Unable to stop the work while the matter was referred to King Darius, Tatnai sent him a detailed letter reporting the project's progress and the Jews' claim that Cyrus had decreed it (Ezra 5:3-17). When Darius confirmed the decree and ordered him to help rather than hinder the builders, Tatnai complied, and the temple was finished under his watch (Ezra 6:6-15).
